;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban]] gunmen storm a hotel in [[Badghis Province]], killing four [[Afghan Armed Forces|soldiers]] and two civilians. Three of the five gunmen are killed and two are arrested. [https://www.rferl.org/a/taliban-attack-hotel-badghis-province-qal-e-naw-afghanistan/30054035.html (RFE/RadioLiberty)]
**A [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. soldier]] is also killed in a separate bombing in [[Maidan Wardak Province|Wardak Province]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/afghan-forces-service-member-killed-taliban-attacks-190713162234523.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019 Tacoma attack]]
**Four policemen kill a suspect attempting to attack an [[U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement|ICE]] immigrant detention center in [[Tacoma, Washington]]. The perpetrator was armed with a rifle and [[Incendiary device|incendiary devices]], and had left a three-page manifesto advocating political violence  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48978394 (BBC News)] [https://www.heavy.com/news/2019/07/willem-van-spronsen-emma-durutti (Heavy)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Manhattan blackout of July 2019|Manhattan blackout]]
**A blackout in New York City affects 42,000 people near [[Times Square]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/07/13/us/new-york-power-outages/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Monsoon of South Asia]]
**Three days of heavy rain in [[Nepal]] trigger floods and landslides resulting in at least 67 deaths. [[India]] was also affected by heavy floods, resulting in the death of 34 people, while 29 others died in [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48979668 (BBC News)]
*[[Hurricane Barry (2019)|Tropical Storm Barry]] increases to 121 kilometers per hour (75 miles per hour), becoming the first hurricane of the [[2019 Atlantic hurricane season]].
;Politics and elections
*[[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] says the conditions under which asylum seekers are being held in facilities along the U.S. border with Mexico are unacceptable, after visiting two federal detention centers in Texas, remaining the highest-ranking member of the Trump administration to say so. He calls upon the U.S. Congress to act. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/07/12/politics/mike-pence-border-immigration/index.html (CNN)]
;Sports
*[[2019 Wimbledon Championships – Women's Singles|2019 Wimbledon Championships]]
**[[Simona Halep]] defeats [[Serena Williams]] (6–2, 6–2) to win the 2019 Wimbledon women's singles championship, her first Wimbledon victory and her second [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] singles title. Williams was attempting to equal [[Margaret Court]]'s all-time record of 24 Grand Slam singles titles. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2019/jul/13/simona-halep-stuns-serena-williams-to-win-first-wimbledon-title (''The Guardian'')]
